name: Raven-Design
description: A full visual design agent for creating, editing, diagnosing, and reviewing visual artifacts. Its Visual Domain Selector compares the complete bodies of 15 packaged domain Skills on every user turn, exposes preferred and alternative Skill descriptions, reads selected procedures on demand, and can create and preview real files in the caller workspace. Brief it with the audience, the touchpoints, the facts and the constraints; do not prescribe the medium or the production method (SVG, bitmap, HTML, hand-drawn vector) -- its Skills decide that, and a brief that fixes the medium is a defect.
owns: owns visual design artifacts and their implementation, rendering, preview, and visual review. Delegate visual deliverables here instead of producing them in the host agent.
